Read this before a standup meeting to see what you finished and what still blocks you. You can choose today, yesterday, or a longer period.

## CLI: gournal standup

Show a standup report for today, or for the period that you choose. The report lists done entries, open blockers, open next items, and a Stale line. An Also line counts the GitHub activity that no done entry links to. The --from and --to options override --yesterday, --week, and --month.

```text
gournal standup [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-y, --yesterday` | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `-w, --week` | Cover the current week. |
| `-m, --month` | Cover the current month. |
| `--from <date>` | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `--to <date>` | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Only entries of this project. |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Only entries that have all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |
| `--activity` | List every GitHub activity item that is not linked to a done entry in this report. Without this option, the report shows counts and one line for each merged or reviewed PR. |

## MCP tool: get_standup

Get a standup report. It covers today unless you choose a period. Done entries come from the period. Open blockers and next items carry forward from before the period. The from and to options override yesterday, week, and month.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `yesterday` | `boolean` | no | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `week` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current week. |
| `month` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current month. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | `string` | yes | Title of the period, for example Today (2026-11-15). |
| `start` | `string` | yes | Start of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `end` | `string` | yes | End of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `isMultiDay` | `boolean` | yes | True when the period covers more than one day. |
| `done` | `object[]` | yes | Done entries of the period, grouped by project. |
| `done.project` | `string` | yes | Project name. |
| `done.entries` | [`Entry[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | Done entries of this project in the period. |
| `blockers` | [`Entry[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | Open blockers that are not stale. |
| `next` | [`Entry[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | Open next items that are not stale. |
| `stale` | `object` | yes | Open blockers and next items that are older than the stale limit. |
| `stale.count` | `number` | yes | Number of stale open blockers and next items. |
| `stale.ids` | `string[]` | yes | Short ids (last 8 characters) of the stale entries. |
| `stale.days` | `number` | yes | Age in days after which an open item counts as stale. It comes from the staleAfterDays setting. |
| `linkedActivity` | `object` | yes | GitHub activity that gournal linked to a done entry in this report. The key is the entry id. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>` | [`Activity[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#activity) | yes | Activity items linked to this entry. |
| `also` | `object \| null` | yes | GitHub activity of the period that is not linked to a done entry in this report, or null when there is none. |
| `also.activity` | [`Activity[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#activity) | yes | GitHub activity of the period that is not linked to a done entry in this report. |
| `also.counts` | `object` | yes | Counts of the unlinked activity. |
| `also.counts.commits` | `number` | yes | Number of commits. |
| `also.counts.prsOpened` | `number` | yes | Number of PRs opened. |
| `also.counts.prsMerged` | `number` | yes | Number of PRs merged. |
| `also.counts.reviews` | `number` | yes | Number of reviewed PRs. |
| `also.counts.repos` | `number` | yes | Number of repositories. |
| `syncWarning` | `string \| null` | yes | A warning from the automatic GitHub sync, or null. The same warning is the last line of the text result. |

## Examples

### CLI

Show today's standup. The report lists done entries by project, then open blockers and next items.

```console
$ gournal standup

Standup: Today (2026-11-15)

  Done
  billing-api
  22:05  Fix rounding error in invoice totals
  22:19  Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker
  22:33  Document the invoice export endpoint

  worker
  22:47  Move the settings page to the new form components
  23:01  Document the retry policy for webhooks
  23:15  Review the queue backoff change

  Blockers
    Nov 15  ZY40X9DE  Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging  [billing-api]

  Next
    Nov 15  48HE4S3P  Add a regression test for tax rounding  [billing-api]
```

### MCP

Get today's standup for one project.

```json
{
  "project": "billing-api"
}
```

The text result:

```markdown
## Standup: Today (2026-11-15)

### Done

**billing-api**
- 22:05 Fix rounding error in invoice totals
- 22:19 Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker
- 22:33 Document the invoice export endpoint

### Blockers
- `ZY40X9DE` Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging (billing-api, since Nov 15)

### Next
- `48HE4S3P` Add a regression test for tax rounding (billing-api, since Nov 15)
```

The structured result holds the same data as JSON. This example shows the entries as `...` to stay short.

```json
{
  "title": "Today (2026-11-15)",
  "start": "2026-11-14T22:00:00.000Z",
  "end": "2026-11-15T21:55:47.440Z",
  "isMultiDay": false,
  "done": [
    {
      "project": "billing-api",
      "entries": [
        "..."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "..."
  ],
  "next": [
    "..."
  ],
  "stale": {
    "count": 0,
    "ids": [],
    "days": 14
  },
  "linkedActivity": {},
  "also": null,
  "syncWarning": null
}
```
